query:
SELECT b.id, b.name
            FROM agent_configs ac
            JOIN bots b ON b.id = ac.bot_id
            WHERE ac.harness_id = $1
              AND b.owner_user_id = $2
              AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND b.has_agent
              AND NOT ac.is_coding
              AND NOT agent_owner_can_run(b.id)
            ORDER BY b.created_at
